description:
Cast Grovetender Druids by paying {2}{G}{W}.
When Grovetender Druids enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Plant creature token.
When the Plant enters the battlefield as an Ally due to Maskwood Nexus, Grovetender Druids triggers.
Holding priority, activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Plant, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the Grovetender Druids trigger, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Plant creature token.
Repeat from step 3.
Once you have infinite mana, you may forego sacrificing the Plants.
